game.title: Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater
game.blurb: Remake of the 2004 stealth action game Metal Gear Solid 3, from Konami and Virtuos, released 2025-08-28. RAWG has no playtime yet. Genre: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Naked Snake's mission in the jungle, boss by boss.

chapters.title: Stealth and CQC
chapters.summary: Camouflage, close-quarters combat, hold-ups, interrogations and sneaky tricks.

chapters.title: Survival and Food
chapters.summary: Capturing and eating animals, curing wounds and the food collection.

chapters.title: Collectibles and Secrets
chapters.summary: Kerotans, GA-KOs, the tsuchinoko, uniforms and face paint, and radio calls.

chapters.title: Playthrough Challenges
chapters.summary: No-kill runs, the FOXHOUND title, play styles and other big goals.
